## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat:` New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix:` Bug fix or patch
- [ ] `docs:` Documentation update
- [ ] `refactor:` Code refactoring without behavioral changes
- [ ] `test:` Adding or improving tests
- [ ] `chore:` Build, CI/CD, dependency, or tooling change

## Checklist

- [ ] My PR title follows the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format (e.g. `feat(scope): short description`)
- [ ] I have executed local unit tests and code formatting (`make test`, `make fmt`, `make lint`)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation / `README.md` if necessary
- [ ] I have maintained all existing safety and dry-run guarantees
